description: Computes Italian IMU property tax (L.160/2019) for buildings (from cadastral income + category), agricultural land (from reddito dominicale) and building land (from market value), with first/second instalment. The rate (‰) is the one set by the municipality: pass it (`aliquota_permille`) OR pass the `comune` (cadastral code or name) and the server uses the rate from its prospetto published by the MEF, with its legal status (prospetto of the year · previous year, L.160/2019 c.767 · base rates) and the source in `aliquota_comune`. If the prospetto has not been read yet, or the municipality has no IMU (Trento, Bolzano, Friuli Venezia Giulia), it answers `calcolato: false` with the explanation, without an amount. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

aliquota_permille.description: Rate set by the municipality, per thousand (e.g. 8.6 for 8.6‰). REQUIRED if you do not pass `comune`; with both, this one wins, and the response says whether it differs from the prospetto.

anno.description: Tax year of the per-municipality verdict (default the current year). Only with `comune`.

categoria_catastale.description: Buildings only: cadastral category as on the visura, without the slash (A/2 → `A2`, C/1 → `C1`). It sets the multiplier and, for `abitazione_principale_A1_A8_A9`, whether the tax is due (only A1, A8, A9) or the home is exempt. `A` without a number applies to dwellings when the number is unknown; if missing, it is computed as `A` and the response says so. Not used with `terreno_agricolo` and `area_edificabile`.

coltivatore_diretto_iap.description: Land: coltivatore diretto/IAP farmer enrolled in agricultural social security → exempt.

comune.description: Cadastral code (e.g. B519) or name of the municipality. The rate becomes the one in its IMU prospetto published by the MEF for the year (or, by law, the previous year's or the base rate).

detrazione.description: Deduction in euro (buildings only; e.g. 200 for a luxury main residence).

esente_montano_isola.description: Land: in a mountain/hill municipality or minor island → exempt.

ex_comune.description: Only merged municipalities with differentiated rates: the former municipality where the property is. If needed and missing, the response lists the possible ones.

mese_fine.description: Last month of ownership counted (12 = December). Default 12.

mese_inizio.description: First month of ownership counted (1 = January; a month counts if owned for more than half its days). With mese_fine the June instalment becomes the tax for the first half-year (L. 160/2019 c. 762). Default 1.

mesi_possesso.description: Months of ownership in the year (default 12). With partial ownership it does not say WHICH months: to split the first and second instalment use mese_inizio/mese_fine.

provincia.description: Province code, for municipalities with the same name (e.g. TO). Only with `comune`.

reddito_dominicale.description: Agricultural land: reddito dominicale from the visura (base = ×1.25×135). REQUIRED with `tipo_immobile: terreno_agricolo`, except when the land is exempt (see the two flags).

rendita_catastale.description: Buildings: annual cadastral income (rendita catastale) in euro (from the visura). REQUIRED for all types other than `terreno_agricolo` and `area_edificabile` — i.e. also for the default type `abitazione_non_principale`.

tipo_immobile.description: Property type → selects the formula (default abitazione_non_principale).

valore_venale.description: Building land: market value as of 1 January (€). REQUIRED with `tipo_immobile: area_edificabile`.

title: Calculate IMU
